business_problem: Ikano Group needed an audit-ready way to gather, govern, and report sustainability data across six diverse businesses because manual preparation for CSRD and ESRS reporting would have been too slow, fragmented, and costly.
solution_summary: Ikano Group, Ikano Insight, and IBM Consulting built a group-wide ESG data-management foundation on IBM Envizi ESG Suite to prepare for CSRD reporting. The teams established a baseline, mapped ESRS requirements, defined data and reporting hierarchies, and configured Envizi virtual accounts so each business could operate as a separate reporting entity while still rolling data up to group level. Envizi automation was then used to streamline data capture and build a traceable governance model that covers disclosures, workflows, and auditor access. IBM Garage methods supported the co-creation of goals and roadmaps, while steering-committee and business-team routines operationalized the process across finance, sustainability, HR, legal, and operations teams. The resulting architecture treats sustainability data with the same rigor as financial data, making it easier for Ikano to capture thousands of data types, track changes to source, and coordinate compliance work across continents.

solution_components.role: Provides the shared ESG data platform for data capture, workflow, governance, and CSRD-aligned reporting across the group.

solution_components.name: IBM Garage

data_flow: Sustainability data from each Ikano business is captured into Envizi virtual accounts and customized hierarchies, automated governance and workflow controls support reporting and audit readiness, and consolidated disclosures roll up to group-level CSRD reporting.
business_outcome: Ikano simplified complex ESG reporting, improved audit readiness, and created a scalable governance model for group-wide sustainability performance tracking and compliance.
